sloka: न च वै म्लानताम् यान्ति न च शीर्यन्ति राघव ।मतंग शिष्याः तत्र आसन् ऋषयः सुसमाहितः ॥३-७३-२३॥
transliteration: na ca vai mlānatām yānti na ca śīryanti rāghava ।mataṁga śiṣyāḥ tatra āsan ṛṣayaḥ susamāhitaḥ ॥3-73-23॥

translations.english: While drops of sweat from the bodies of sage Matanga's disciples fell on earth under the heavy load of forest products they carried for their preceptor, they remained in a calm state. Those drops of sweat turned into flowers and those flowers do not wither due to the power of penance of the sages.
translations.hindi: यही वह प्रत्यक्स्थल नाम की वेदी है, जहाँ बैठ कर मेरे पूज्य णुरुलोग पुष्पाञ्जलि ( वृद्धावस्था के कारण ) थरथराते हुए हाथों 8 अपण किआ करते थे
